blocks.orig: The Pazuri Inn is located on Arusha’s outskirts, one hour from Kilimanjaro International Airport and en route to Tarangire National Park. It has a swimming pool, a restaurant with lounge, a bar, an outdoor terrace, a fireplace, and a TV room for watching football matches with other guests. Rooms are available for up to four people, furnished with king-size and/or twin beds, mosquito nets, and an ensuite bathroom. The Pazuri Inn is suitable for stays before or after a flight, and before or after a safari in the northern parks.
blocks.html: The Pazuri Inn sits on the edge of Arusha, an hour from Kilimanjaro International Airport and on the way to Tarangire National Park. Facilities include a swimming pool, a restaurant with a lounge, a bar, an outdoor terrace, a fireplace and a TV room where you can watch football with other guests. Rooms sleep up to four people and have king-size and/or twin beds, mosquito nets and an ensuite bathroom. The Pazuri Inn works well for a stay before or after a flight, and before or after a safari in the northern parks.
